entries.environment: PlayDrop prod hosted dev shell with local final build
actions: Loaded the final hosted dev build directly into the endless opening.
Tapped once and observed the textured chopping knife leave its blade-tip start pivot and begin a forward flip.
Tapped a second time after 420ms and observed the knife cut through the opening wall, award seven points, and send physical brick fragments into the course.
Continued tapping at 520ms intervals and reached the orange and emoji target lane with visible split halves and a best score of ten.
Tapped once without recovery input and observed a partial wall cut followed by a readable side-stab pressure state.
Recorded the final preview through PlayDrop native capture at an exact 390x844 portrait gameplay viewport.
statesObserved: Direct-to-endless ready state with no blocking overlay
Textured and correctly oriented PlayDrop chopping-knife GLB
Multiple airborne taps preserve forward travel and add another visible rotation
Blade contact cuts seven wall courses and leaves independently simulated debris
Orange targets split into visible halves while the run continues into the authored emoji and camera beats
Bad timing remains readable and recoverable through the side-stab and rotating-stick states
Native portrait capture fills 390x844 edge to edge without desktop chrome or letterboxing
Hosted runtime reaches ready with hardware WebGL and no uncaught console errors
entries.webglRenderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M2 Pro, Unspecified Version)

primaryInput.action: tap once in the center of the portrait game frame, then wait 260ms
primaryInput.observed: the chopping knife leaves its blade-tip start pivot and visibly flips forward toward the opening wall

win.action: tap, wait 420ms, tap again, then wait 520ms
win.observed: the blade cuts through the opening wall, the score and best update to seven, and physical brick debris separates behind the planted knife

loss.action: tap once and provide no recovery tap for 1800ms
loss.observed: the knife makes only a partial wall cut and enters a readable side-stab pressure state instead of silently clipping or teleporting
